note: Threshold-based drought early warning using district SPI-6 severity, trajectory, and decline run. Status tiers: Normal (no concern), Watch (mild drought or deteriorating), Warning (moderate+ drought or 3+ month decline), Alert (severe/extreme drought sustained).
limitations: District SPI-12 infeasible on 16-year ERA5 window; only SPI-3/SPI-6 computed
SPI nowcast is a condition indicator, not a probabilistic forecast
Validation uses documented drought events; small sample (4 droughts) limits statistical power
